notes: Chronic kidney disease and COPD visits. Synthetic, invented speakers.

cases.title: CKD stage 4: potassium, fluids, erythropoietin, labs
lines: Doctor: Her kidney function has settled at stage four, so the rules below are permanent.
Doctor: Stop the ibuprofen completely, it is hard on the kidneys.
Doctor: Never take any painkiller from the shop without asking the renal nurse.
Nurse: Reduce the potassium, so no banana, coconut water or orange juice.
Doctor: Keep the fluid to four glasses a day, that includes tea and curd.
Nurse: Note the swelling in her ankles every evening and record the weight chart.
Doctor: Take the erythropoietin injection every Sunday evening, in the clinic.
Doctor: The dietitian will see her after that, and we repeat the creatinine before the next visit.
Doctor: We will check the phosphate and the haemoglobin before you come back on 12/12.

cases.title: COPD: inhaler technique, spacer, steroid rinse, smoking
lines: Doctor: His breathlessness is about the same, the chest is tight in the mornings.
Doctor: Use the salbutamol inhaler two puffs when he is breathless, and rinse the mouth after.
Doctor: Use the steroid inhaler two puffs every morning, then one puff at night.
Nurse: Make sure he rinses the mouth and spits after each steroid puff, thrush is the problem.
Nurse: Please note the spacer must be used for the steroid puff, it cuts the thrush.
Doctor: Stop smoking this year, the inhalers cannot hold on while the smoke continues.
Doctor: Walk for ten minutes twice a day, and rest if the breath is bad.
Nurse: Come back in three weeks if the breathlessness is worse, sooner if he needs the inhaler more than four times a day.
Doctor: Keep the rescue inhaler at the bedside, not in the bag.
